content.contents: i use pinterest sometimes just for, y'know, finding outfit inspiration, looking at cool guitars and sometimes for minecraft builds and stuff
and it's painful to use sometimes just because of the sheer amount of ads, but
what's with all the gay hentai ads?

and no, don't you dare ask why i know what those words are, it's nothing to do with me
